description: Na₂Ca(CO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.95 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.68 Å. Ca is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.64 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.29 Å) and one longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond length. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.29 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Ca, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Na, two equivalent Ca, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Ca, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, two equivalent Ca, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one C atom.
